g.title: looped_dinov2
g.text: Looped DINOv2 with image-level adaptive halting — training pipeline
T_max = 4, L = 3 default. Student in lockstep across all recursion steps; teacher at T_max only with no halting.

g.title: cluster_shared_stack
g.text: SharedStack — L = 3 weight-tied blocks, applied T_max = 4 times
recurrence: z_t = post_LN( Block_L ∘ ··· ∘ Block_1 ( pre_LN( z_{t-1} + τ_t ) ) ) + z₀

g.title: cluster_halt
g.text: Image-level halt head (mean-pool the image's 8 CLS tokens, h_t = σ(W_halt · z̄_t))

g.title: cluster_dino
g.text: Per-step DINO CLS loss L^DINO_t (cross-view CE vs. teacher CLS at T_max)

g.title: cluster_ibot
g.text: Per-step iBOT patch loss L^iBOT_t (masked tokens vs. teacher patches at T_max)

g.title: cluster_teacher
g.text: Teacher (EMA of student, T_max only, no halt head)

g.title: pmarg
g.text: p_t = h_t · ∏_{s<t} (1 − h_s); p_{T_max} absorbs remainder; ∑_t p_t = 1

g.title: total
g.text: L = Σ_t p_t · ( L^DINO_t + w_iBOT · L^iBOT_t )
